messages:
maya: Quick heads-up: after rolling kernel-selector v2 at 09:12 UTC we observed an 8-12% p99 latency regression on A10 and L4 in continuous-batching workloads. perf-bot alerted at 09:14. KV-fragmentation rate jumped ~2.6x which looks correlated.

raj: Do we have the flamegraph + CPU/GPU timelines? Link?

maya: Flamegraph and timeline attached: https://internals.redwood/ci/3832/flame.html and perf-bot traces: https://perf.redwood/reports/3832

henrik: Initial skim — kernel fallback freq increased on short-seq slices. Looks like the kernel-fit threshold change favored a faster but KV-unfriendly kernel for seq < 64.

sasha: Could explain KV cache pressure. If we pack more tiny requests into the same slot the KV fragments and increases memory churn.

maya: Current per-gpu defaults: A10 max_tokens_per_batch=131072, L4=98304, T4=65536, A100=196608, H100=262144. Candidate tweak: reduce L4/A10 by 20% and add a soft cap for requests <64 to force kernel v1.

raj: Can we express the soft cap as rule: if median_seq < 64 then prefer kernel_v1, else kernel_v2? Also adjust slot ceiling: slot_max_tokens = min(device_ceiling, request_budget + kv_overhead_margin).

henrik: Quick profiling snippet:
```
KV-frag-rate: baseline 0.12 -> after rollout 0.31
Kernel_v2 fallback: 18% -> 43% for seq<64
GPU occupancy (A10): 52% -> 46%
p99 latency: 84ms -> 96ms
```

emily: I can run a controlled run on staging with these two changes: L4/A10 -20% batch caps + kernel preference rule. Will post numbers.

sasha: Also consider a short-term mitigation: lower batching window from 12ms -> 8ms for A10/L4 to reduce tiny-request packing.

perf-bot: synthetic-bench 3832100000 queued: starting run on staging. ETA ~12m.

emily: Results (staging): p50 ~ same, p95 improved 3%, p99 improved 9% on A10 after -20% cap + kernel rule. T4 unchanged. Heap KV-moves down 27%.

maya: Nice. Proposal: ship temporary device-profile patch with L4/A10 caps lowered by 20% and kernel rule, monitor 24h, revert if throughput drop >6%. Anyone object?

raj: :thumbsup: do it. add experiment flag so we can toggle per-region.

henrik: I'll prepare the rollout PR and include perf graphs + jq diff for device-config.

maya: Thanks — leaving the thread here. Follow-up plan: 24h observability dashboard, ticket PERF-1142 for postmortem + long-term kernel selection revisit.
